# HSC Proposal Template

This is the master template for Houston Sign Crafters proposals. PB14 (Proposal Deal Room) renders
these sections as a private, trackable web page; until PB14 ships, fill it in and send as PDF.
Placeholders use `{{double_braces}}`. Every number must come from the survey + estimate — never
leave an unverified figure in a sent proposal.

House style: plain English, front-loaded, short sentences. The proposal is sent AFTER the call and
on-site survey, together with the free design mockup — it never goes out before those happen.

## 5. What's included

- Site survey and exact measurements (done {{survey_date}})
- Design mockups and revisions until approval
- Engineering drawings where required
- Permit preparation, submission, and management with {{jurisdiction}}
- Fabrication in our Houston shop, UL-certified components
- Landlord/property-manager sign-criteria coordination where applicable
- Installation by our own crew, including {{install_equipment}}
- Final inspection and walkthrough with you

## 6. What's not included

List every exclusion explicitly. Common ones — delete any that don't apply:

- Primary electrical service to the sign location (by customer's electrician unless quoted above)
- Landlord approval fees, if the property charges them
- Structural repairs to the fascia/wall beyond normal mounting
- Removal/disposal of existing signage (unless itemized above)
- After-hours or weekend installation (unless itemized above)

We don't fabricate before the permit is approved — it protects you from paying for a sign the city
or your landlord won't allow.

## 8. Warranty

Every sign we build carries our 5-year warranty covering fabrication defects and workmanship,
including LEDs and electrical components we supply. Service calls in Greater Houston are handled by
our own crew, not a subcontractor.

## 11. Common questions

**Can the design still change?** Yes — revisions are free until you approve final artwork. After
fabrication starts, changes are re-quoted.

**What if the permit is denied?** It almost never is when we handle the drawings — but if the city
rejects the application outright, we redesign to comply or refund the unused portion of your
deposit. You are never stuck paying for a sign that can't be installed.

**Who talks to my landlord?** We do. Send us the property contact and sign criteria and we handle
approval as part of the project.

**How long is this price good for?** {{validity_days}} days. Material prices move; after that we
re-confirm before you commit.

---

*Template notes (delete before sending): keep it to 2–3 pages plus photos. Front-load the number —
customers who have to hunt for the price don't trust the proposal. One CTA only. Never include a
stat, timeline, or claim you can't back with a real project or written confirmation.*
